title: Technology and Disintermediation in Online Marketplaces
eligible_reason: Single adoption date and no data. The shock is China's Skype block (late 2017): treated = freelancer located in mainland China, post = job finished after Feb 1, 2018 (pre period Jan 1-Sep 30, 2017), so treated_x_post is a two-group single-date DiD. Regressions are job-assignment-level OLS (reg ... treated post) or xtreg with assignment-month FE plus job/client characteristics, not unit FE. The data are proprietary under NDA and not included (MainSample.dta and AggregatedSample.dta are absent).
design_notes: Job-assignment-level repeated cross-section from an online outsourcing platform. Outcomes ldtr_1 (log disintermediation score), ltotal_charge_1, lhours. Main tables: reg y treated post treated_x_post (col 1) and xtreg y treated post treated_x_post timely_job comm_med comm_high need_qualification personal cl_experienced, i(assg_month) fe r. Heterogeneity: treated##post##moderator. Robustness: stayers (stay_dummy), hourly vs fixed-price (ishr).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One shock date (Skype block in China).

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; no unit FE; data not shipped
specs.treatment_var: treated_x_post (treated = freelancer in mainland China; post = after Skype block)
specs.controls: treated post timely_job comm_med comm_high need_qualification personal cl_experienced
